title: fix(plugin-auth): a refused SAML sign-in lands on the error URL, as OIDC does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XGDSuSNY1BXB5hKz8ADFAn2)_
Fixes #30966

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：SAML 登录被拒时（典型是邮箱属于一个尚未关联该 IdP 的已有账号，`account_not_linked`），不再跳回「登录成功」页，而是跳到登录时给的 `errorCallbackURL`；没给就跳到平台登录页，与 OIDC 以及 SAML 其它拒绝一致。响应过大被拒时原来跳到站点根，也一并改为错误页。`error=`、`error_description` 原样保留。
- **为什么改**：用户会看到一个看似登录了、其实没登录的页面（cloud#3666 用 Okta / Entra 实测）。原因在上游 `@better-auth/sso`：账号类拒绝被发往成功地址。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 SAML ACS 拒绝时的跳转目标，不放行任何登录；成功登录、IdP 发起的登录（无 relay state）不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts` 末尾的 SAML 一节（风险在 `readSamlAcsLanding` 的安全规则与 `landSamlRefusal` 的成功判定）；`auth-manager-request-routing.ts`（同一作用域挂载点）；`sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`（真实 ACS 端到端）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`，预期 15 个用例全绿（含成功对照与 takeover 落到错误页）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 `processSAMLResponse` sends nearly every SAML refusal to the flow's error URL (`samlErrorRedirectUrl`: the sign-in's `errorCallbackURL`, else `onAPIError.errorURL`, which plugin-auth points at the Console login page). Two refusals do not:

1. An account refusal from better-auth's `handleOAuthUserInfo` comes back as `result.error`, and the vendor answers `ctx.redirect(buildSAMLRedirectUrl(callbackUrl, { error }))`: the SUCCESS `callbackURL` with only `?error=`. Values: `account_not_linked` (the takeover case on the card), `signup_disabled`, `unable_to_link_account`, `unable_to_create_user`, `email_not_verified`, `unable_to_create_session`.
2. A response over `maxResponseSize` is refused before the vendor reads the relay state, so it lands on the provider's fallback candidates. For a provider stored by the Register SAML Provider bridge (whose `callbackUrl` is the ACS itself) that is the app origin `/`.

The cause is upstream, so the fix wraps the ACS in plugin-auth at the seam PR #31194 uses for the OIDC callback, as the seat ruled. There is no vendored patch.

- **One scope for both callbacks.** `auth-manager-request-routing.ts` now asks `ssoCallbackOf(endpointPath, request)`, which answers the OIDC callback (unchanged) or a `POST` to `/sso/saml2/sp/acs/:providerId`. Both run through the one host member `AuthManager.runSsoCallback` (renamed from `runSsoOidcCallback`) and `runSsoCallbackScope` in `sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts`. The OIDC branch calls the existing `runSsoOidcCallbackScope` unchanged. The file keeps its name and gains a "SAML: where a refusal lands" header section.
- **Where the error URL comes from.** The vendor computes `samlErrorRedirectUrl` from the relay state and offers no hook on it, and it deletes the relay-state row once read. So before the vendor runs, `readSamlAcsLanding` reads the same row (`auth-state:RELAY_STATE`) through the vendor's own `internalAdapter.findVerificationValue`, which does not consume it. It applies the vendor's default (`onAPIError.errorURL`, else `${baseURL}/error`) and the vendor's redirect safety rule (`getSafeRedirectCandidate`: a same-origin path not starting `//` or `/\`, or an absolute URL on the app origin or a trusted origin, never the ACS itself). No relay state, no row, an unreadable row, an unsafe target, or a throw while reading means no landing, and the vendor's answer stands.
- **The rewrite.** `landSamlRefusal` re-bases a redirect whose `Location` carries `error=` and is not the success URL onto the error URL, keeping `error` and `error_description` as the vendor wrote them. It builds the URL as the vendor's `buildSAMLRedirectUrl` does: values set on the target, and a relative target kept relative. A refusal already on the error URL comes out byte-identical; status and every other header are kept. `error=` is never changed (seat ruling).
- **Not here:** the SAML refusal causes in `error_description` (#31168, waiting on upstream). Neither field's value changes, so this PR and #31168 stay separable. No `packages/spec`, ADR-0112, or package export change (`index.ts` still exports only the OIDC cause constants).
- **Docs:** `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` "SAML sign-in flow" gains step 5 (where a refusal lands) and names the optional `errorCallbackURL`.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, `.changeset/30966-saml-refusal-lands-on-error-url.md`.

### Every SAML ACS refusal, and where it lands

Measured with this PR's rig on `origin/main` `66bf5b4a` (before) and on the head (after), sign-in with `errorCallbackURL` given:

| Refusal | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `account_not_linked` (takeover) | `callbackURL?error=account_not_linked` | `errorCallbackURL?error=account_not_linked` |
| same, no `errorCallbackURL` | `callbackURL?error=account_not_linked` | Console login page `?error=account_not_linked` |
| other `handleOAuthUserInfo` results (`signup_disabled`, `unable_to_link_account`, `unable_to_create_user`, `email_not_verified`, `unable_to_create_session`) | `callbackURL` (same vendor line, read in source) | `errorCallbackURL` (same rule; not driven end to end) |
| response over `maxResponseSize` | app origin `/?error=saml_error&…` | `errorCallbackURL?error=saml_error&…` |
| signature / parse failure (`saml_error`) | `errorCallbackURL` | unchanged |
| no assertion (`saml_no_assertion`) | `errorCallbackURL` | unchanged |
| unknown or expired request ID, audience, recipient, replay, `invalid_state` variants, `resolveUser` / `validateUserInfo` refusals (APIError with a code, e.g. plugin-auth's own implicit-link gate) | error URL (vendor source; the request-ID case measured) | unchanged |
| relay state the vendor cannot read | vendor fallback (no error URL known) | unchanged |
| provider not found (404), unverified domain (401), `POST` without `SAMLResponse` (400) | JSON answers, not redirects | unchanged |
| IdP-initiated response (no `RelayState`) | vendor candidates | unchanged (no relay state to read) |

## Tests

New `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`, 15 cases.

- **End of the chain:** a real `AuthManager` with the real `sso()` plugin over the in-memory engine, driven `/sign-in/sso` → IdP → `POST` ACS. The IdP is played with the `samlify` the installed `@better-auth/sso` resolves (loaded through `createRequire` from the vendor's own location, so no new dependency). It reads the vendor's SP metadata and AuthnRequest ID and answers a Response signed with an RSA key and a self-signed certificate generated in the test (a small DER builder checked by `X509Certificate`), so each refusal comes from the vendor's real pipeline.
  - CONTROL: a new account signs in, 302 to `callbackURL`, session cookie set.
  - Takeover: 302 to `errorCallbackURL` with `error=account_not_linked`, no session.
  - Takeover with no `errorCallbackURL`: the Console login page, the same page the vendor's own `saml_error` refusal lands on in the same sign-in shape.
  - Takeover with a relative `errorCallbackURL`: `/oops?from=sso&error=account_not_linked`.
  - Oversized response: `errorCallbackURL`, `error=saml_error`, description kept.
  - Tampered assertion (already on the error URL): unchanged.
- **Units:** the path and method scope; reading the landing from a form or JSON body, the default, the absent or unreadable row; the safety rule (untrusted origin, trusted origin, `//`, `/\`, the ACS itself, a relative path); the rewrite keeps headers and both params, leaves a success alone even when its own URL carries `error=`, leaves an already-landed refusal and a non-redirect identical; no landing, or a throw while reading it, leaves the vendor answer.

Red first on `origin/main` `66bf5b4a` (first version of the file, CONTROL + takeover): 1 failed, 1 passed; the takeover case received `base: http://localhost:3000/after-sign-in` for `sign-in-failed`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with blob == HEAD 9e4e9e53 and `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

The test imports the module from `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` rebuild sits between a mutation and its reading.

1. The scope no longer wraps the SAML ACS (`ssoCallbackOf` matches method `ABLATED-1` instead of `POST`): 5 failed / 10 passed (the four end-to-end refusal cases and the scope unit).
2. The safety rule off (`readSamlAcsLanding` takes the raw error URL): 1 failed / 14 passed ("applies the vendor redirect safety rule").
3. The success guard off (`location === landing.success` never true): 1 failed / 14 passed ("leaves a success alone, even one whose own URL carries error=").
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Reading: "as the OIDC callback does" also covers the sign-in with no `errorCallbackURL`. The OIDC callback then lands on `onAPIError.errorURL` (the Console login page), and so does every other SAML refusal; this PR sends the account refusals there too instead of to `callbackURL`. The card's literal "when one is given" case is the first end-to-end refusal test.
- The landing reads one vendor-internal spelling, the relay-state identifier `auth-state:RELAY_STATE` (better-auth `getAuthStateVerificationIdentifier`, not exported). A vendor bump that renames it makes `readSamlAcsLanding` find no row, and the end-to-end takeover cases go red (ablation 1 is the same shape), so it cannot fall back silently. plugin-auth always runs better-auth with a database, so the relay state is always database-stored (`storeStateStrategy` is never set here).
- The safety rule is a copy of the vendor's (`getSafeRedirectCandidate` and `isSafeSAMLRedirectPath` are not exported); it only ever narrows: an error URL it refuses leaves the vendor's answer as is.
- No new log line: the SAML cause log line belongs to #31168.
- Clause-② measured: the only answer that changes is the `Location` of a refused ACS `POST` (302 either way). Nothing is admitted, no status, body, `error=` or `error_description` changes, and no published type or export changes. So `no`, as the claim read it.
- Upstream: the one-line fix would be `callbackUrl` → `errorUrl` in that `result.error` redirect, plus reading the relay state before the size check. Not filed here.
